description: Lists an account's guardrail revisions, newest first (limit 1 to 50, default 20; before for the next page). Each revision has source (api, approval, rollback, system), actor, changed_fields, loosened, tightened, before, after and restore_body (an update_account_settings body that puts the earlier values back). Applies when the user asks what changed, who changed it, or wants to restore an earlier rule set.
name: list_guardrail_changes
title: Guardrail change history
